newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Powerful quake rocks northwest Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Powerful quake rocks northwest Colombia.

text.p: A powerful earthquake rocked a remote mostly jungle-covered area of northwest Colombia on Sunday but no deaths or injuries were reported and it passed virtually unnoticed in most parts of the country, authorities said.

A spokesman for the national seismological institute, Ingeominas, said the tremor, which was centred in northwestern Choco province on Colombia's Pacific coast, occurred at 12:29 p.m. local time (1729 GMT) and measured 6.2 on the open-ended Richter scale.
It was capable of causing serious damage in a populated area but there were no reports of any injuries or destruction stemming from the tremor, the spokesman said.
He said hundreds of people had been made homeless in Choco over the weekend, however, after flash floods triggered by recent heavy rains in the deeply impoverished area.
